physical_spec_and_typography.font_family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

layout_description: Build a large clean two-by-two factorial table in the center, with two column headers and two row headers. The first row is dependency retention off, the second on; the first column is validity checking off, the second on. Cell identifiers must be exactly 00, 01, 10, 11 in reading order. Above it place a single wide shared-conditions strip. Beneath the table place three equal endpoint cards. Use thin gray grid lines with heavier blue outside borders, and white cell fills. Do not use heatmap colors or numerical results. No data-flow arrow is required inside the table because the four cells are comparison groups, not sequential steps.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: 核心机制实验采用“保留动作依赖/不保留动作依赖”与“核验当前有效性/不核验当前有效性”的交叉设计。四组共享原文档案、执行模型和候选证据规模，并在局部机制回放中匹配Token与实际查询开销，以分离更多上下文带来的影响；完整系统实验只匹配总预算上限，保留自然执行的实际调用差异，不添加无效调用强行配平成本。
caption_note: 依赖保留与有效性核验的交叉设计及共同评测条件
